Important Information Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4.
